content_metadata.description: An analysis of Jo Jorgensen's interview on Fox Business conducted by Kennedy, focusing on third-party voting, the challenges faced by third-party candidates, and the impact of Jo Jorgensen's candidacy.

qAndA.answer: She is campaigning in the same states as the major party candidates and appealing to voters disillusioned with Trump's unfulfilled promises as an 'outsider'.
qAndA.question: Besides being on the ballot in all 50 states, how else is Jo Jorgensen different from other third-party candidates?

qAndA.answer: Kennedy had a heated debate on Twitter about third-party voting.
qAndA.question: What was the nature of the previous interview that Kennedy mentions at the beginning?

qAndA.answer: She says they both want to spend taxpayer money and control people's lives.
qAndA.question: What is one specific point Jo Jorgensen makes about both Democrats and Republicans?

qAndA.answer: As a mother with school-aged children, she prioritizes who will spend the most money on education and who has a plan to pay for it.
qAndA.question: What is Kennedy's personal reason for not voting for a third-party candidate this election?

qAndA.answer: They are both fans of Gary Johnson. Kennedy admires him as a celiac triathlete.
qAndA.question: What common ground does Kennedy share with Jo Jorgensen, adding a personal touch to the end of the interview?

youtube_description:
Dr. Jo Jorgensen, Libertarian Party Candidate for President 2020, was interviewed by Lisa "Kennedy" Montgomery on Fox Business on November 2nd, 2020. This was the 2nd time she was on the show, the first being on October 19, 2020.

Visit Dr. Jorgensen's official campaign website at https://jo20.com/
